title: Files and Games panels — do they still pop open?

steps.surface: Files and Games panels, chat view
steps.path: In chat view, click the Files button in the header, close it, then click Games
steps.headline: Open Files, then Games, a few times. Does each panel glide open instead of popping?
steps.changed: Opening either panel used to show it whole in a single frame. It now fades in while wiping open from the right edge, over about a quarter of a second. The chat narrows once, straight away, and the panel glides into the space it frees; the chat is deliberately not squeezed smoothly, because that re-wraps every message on every frame and stutters on long chats.
steps.notice: A soft, quick reveal from the right. The chat text should jump to its narrower width once and then hold still, never wobble. Closing is NOT animated yet; that is the next step and needs a bigger change.
steps.risk: If the reveal looks like a wipe rather than a glide, or the chat's single jump bothers you, say so in the note; both are tunable.

steps.surface: Files and Games panels, chat view
steps.path: Leave a panel open, then switch to another tab and back, and press Ctrl+` to flip to terminal view and back
steps.headline: With a panel already open, switch tabs and flip views. Does the panel stay put, without re-playing its opening?
steps.changed: The app rebuilds the panel whenever you switch tabs or flip between chat and terminal view. The opening animation is tied to the act of opening, so a panel that was already open should simply be there.
steps.notice: The panel appears with the rest of the conversation and never wipes in a second time. In terminal view the panel opens instantly, exactly as it does today; it gets the animation together with closing.
